summary: Web portal for public poetry collection

existing_features.title: Create a home page displaying a grid or list of all poems with their titles and authors, allowing users to click through to read the full poem
Create a poem detail page that displays the full poem content including title, author, content text, and date created
Create an admin interface or form to add new poems to the collection with fields for title, content, and author

Apply a creative, literary-inspired visual theme with elegant typography, warm earth tones or soft pastels, and a clean layout that emphasizes readability and creates a contemplative atmosphere suitable for poetry

new_feature_requests.summary: Create web portal for poetry collection
Create a backend data model to store poems with fields: title (text), content (text), author (text), dateCreated (timestamp), and a unique identifier
Implement backend methods to add new poems, retrieve all poems, and retrieve a single poem by ID
